ctx.x: Well you can put it in a different way. I’d be happy if you did.

No, I’m half kidding, but half kind of acknowledging. I think what happens is I don’t think anybody really tried to be an innovator. I think a lot of it was just natural growth. And the interesting thing is a friend I work with came back from Banff. I went to Banff right out of college. It’s a jazz workshop in the Canadian Rockies. When I went there Dave Holland was running the program. So coming out of North Texas State kind of, I needed to listen up a little bit let’s say, and that’s actually where Muhal…

and Tony, why did they play “Autumn Leaves” every night when they were recording “ESP?” You know? Why was their set, I mean as far as the material they chose, basically the same every night for three — and over the three years they added a few things, but for the most part they were playing “Footprints” I mean they added some new tunes. They added “Footprints” and they added “Agitation” but they still played “’Round Midnight” and they had a set. And it was like why do you think those guys played those tunes all…
